# React templates

Use these templates as stack-specific starting points alongside the common [template catalog](../../../../docs/templates/README.md). Copy the template into the target project's `docs/` area, remove prompts that do not apply, and verify assumptions against its package manifests, framework, routing, rendering, and deployment setup.

| Template | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [Feature specification](spec.md) | Capture user flows, component state, browser behavior, API contracts, and accessibility requirements. |
| [Verification plan](verification-plan.md) | Plan React build, type, test, browser, accessibility, and security evidence. |
| [Threat-model prompts](threat-model-prompts.md) | Add browser/client and React-specific threat questions to the common threat model. |
| [UI design exploration](design-exploration.md) | Plan a mocked-data React prototype, themes, styling overrides, and design-system updates. |
| [Component styleguide entry](component-styleguide-entry.md) | Document a reusable component's API, states, accessibility, tokens, and theme behavior. |
